method: Visual review of all 712 actual crops across 39 contact sheets; full-resolution checks of seven originals for suspected edge truncation; measured actual divider bands on sheet-fs169-fs184, then reinspected all 16 corrected crops. Matching garment features, complete silhouettes, hems, headwear, shoes and neighboring-cell contamination were checked. This is an AI-assisted material review, not professional garment or whole-library certification.

issues.finding: 原图四行高度不相等，旧等分切图混入上一格鞋子，同时截掉本格鞋底。
issues.resolution: 按全分辨率原图实际格线登记列、行边界，并重新检查16幅切图。
